description: Check where the user can publish a finished video: which platforms this site offers (YouTube, X), which of the user's accounts are connected, today's YouTube limit, the credit cost of an X post and the user's credits. Call this before offering to publish and before publish_video. If nothing is connected, give the user `connect_url` (connecting needs a browser sign-in) and call this again when they say it is done.
name: get_publishing_status
title: Publishing accounts and limits
